summary: Phase 7 of plan v3 (plans/03_direct-route-forest.md) is COMPLETE: `boxI_lift` (the tree-cascade Lifting Lemma, Simpson 8.1.3) is landed in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Labelled/Soundness.lean, sorry-free and axiom-clean. This continuation dispatch added the ancestor-walk assembly on top of the already-committed `raise_subtree`/`ht_le_of_reflTransGen`: `siblings_disjoint` (a small reusable sibling-closure-disjointness helper, generalizing the disjointness argument already proved inline inside `raise_subtree`'s `insert` case), `boxI_lift_ancestor` (the Finset-exclusion-parametrized ancestor-walk induction that fixes the previously-diagnosed unsoundness), and `boxI_lift` itself (a thin wrapper specializing `excl := ∅`). Documented, necessary correction to the prior handoff's transcribed schema (not a design re-opening): `boxI_lift_ancestor`'s edge conjunct checks Finset-exclusion membership via the edge's TARGET, not its SOURCE as the handoff's schema had it -- the source-side check is unprovable at the boundary edge into the excluded branch (e.g. the ancestor edge q -> z itself), since `cs5FCIncest` has no 'raise-source-only, keep-target-exact' conjunct. The two-piece downward/ancestor decomposition and all five key decisions recorded in the dispatch-1 handoff are otherwise unchanged and were followed verbatim.
next_phase_hint: Phase 8: Main NIK induction (motive amended), close boxI case, assemble nik_TS5_soundness. boxI_lift is now available with the exact audit §3 signature the plan's Phase 8 task list expects.

deviations.description: boxI_lift_ancestor's edge conjunct (conjunct 3) checks the Finset-exclusion antecedent via the edge's target `b`, not the source `a` as the dispatch-1 handoff's transcribed schema specified.
deviations.reason: Checking via `a` is unprovable at the boundary edge into the excluded branch (source outside the excluded closure, target inside it, e.g. the ancestor edge q -> z): cs5FCIncest has no raise-source-only-keep-target-exact conjunct, so r(raised q)(old ρ z) is not generally derivable. Checking via `b` correctly drops exactly the boundary edge (established separately by the caller's own cs5FCIncest_raise fact) from the internal obligation. Documented in boxI_lift_ancestor's docstring; the overall strategy is unchanged.
